verdict.rationale: PayPal documents registrable webhooks (HTTPS posts to a subscribed listening URL), automated payment recovery for failed subscription payments, and agent-toolkit tools such as send_invoice_reminder, list_transaction and subscription management. Together these cover monitoring, retries and dunning-style outreach in principle. However, the evidence never names failed-payment webhook event types, and recovery is a built-in automation rather than something an agent is shown to drive via API. missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook events, an API or agent tool for triggering or configuring payment retries, subscription dunning outreach controls, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: Webhooks are HTTPS posts from PayPal to an endpoint on your server whenever the corresponding event type occurs
The initial setup for receiving webhooks is to subscribe a listening URL for a specific app
Automate payment recovery for failed payments.
